note: hecks_qa SW-tenant_ledger-1789342761 (differential fuzz seed 2, shrunk 25 -> 2 steps) — Ruby's `CommandRules::References#enforce_tenant_boundary` (lib/hecks/runtime/command_rules/references.rb, added by PR #595 for ANGLE-8) refuses `TenantLedger::Transfer.Request` with `Unauthorized`/`cross_tenant_reference` whenever the caller's own declared `region:` disagrees with the `region` of the `ledger:` it names — a write-side mirror of `TenantScope.apply`'s query-side `authorize ..., tenant:` boundary. The Rust port never received an equivalent: `tenant_field_for` (an aggregate's own tenant field, read off one of ITS OWN queries' `authorize policy, tenant: :field` declaration) is derived ONLY inside `rust/codegen/src/queries.rs`/`read_models.rs` for query generation — no such derivation, and no matching post-mutation check, exists in `rust/codegen/src/registry.rs`'s command-dispatch emission at all. The plain EXISTENCE check on `ledger:` (`check_reference`, `rust/kernel/repository.rs`) already runs correctly and matches Ruby byte-for-byte when the named Ledger doesn't exist at all — this gap is narrower and newer: the referenced Ledger DOES exist, just in a different region/tenant, which nothing on the Rust side ever inspects. Confirmed via `rust/src/generated/tenant_ledger/registry.rs`: `check_reference(&store.ledger, &args.ledger, "Ledger", "code")` runs for `Transfer.Request`, nothing else does. Rust instead accepts the write outright: creates the `Transfer` instance, emits `TransferRequested`, then runs `SettleAcrossRegions` to completion (`Ledger::Credit` dispatched, `LedgerCredited` emitted, crediting the wrong-tenant Ledger's balance) — real, incorrect work Ruby correctly refuses before it ever happens. `RefusalTemplate { refusal: "Unauthorized", site: "cross_tenant_reference", ... }` is already generated into `rust/src/generated/meta/vocabulary.rs` (the wording template ships with every domain regardless), but it is never invoked from generated dispatch code anywhere in the corpus — confirmed by grep, zero non-metadata call sites before this fix.
